collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — INNER LIFE, PART VIII (141-160, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager made the best stew of their life tonight, and nobody said a word about it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) made the stew tonight. (subject.He/She) tried something new: a pinch of a sour green herb, and the fish cooked just a little less than usual. (subject.He/She) thinks it's the best stew (subject.he/she) has ever made. Everyone ate it. Nobody said a word about it. (subject) is now sitting by the empty pot, slightly deflated.

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: "How was the stew?" (subject) asks (friend), trying to sound casual. (friend) looks up. "Oh! It was wonderful. I had two bowls. I didn't think to say." Then, louder: "Did everybody like the stew?" A chorus of "yes!" comes back from round the fire. (subject) sits up a little straighter.

b__fx.name: Answer B
b__fx.text: (subject) cleans the pot without a word. The stew was good. (subject.He/She) knows it was good. Next morning, though, (subject.he/she) finds that someone has quietly scraped the last bits out of the pot and left a little flower on the lid. (subject.He/She) never finds out who.
